text:
vlad_p: Quick proposal 1: run a regional shadow + holdback rollout for model-routing (route to regionally optimized model variants when latency < threshold). Goal: validate latency + cost improvements while keeping GA risk low. Thoughts?

sarah_prod: Love it. Key requirement: non-disruptive by default (shadow mode first), clear guardrails for automatic holdbacks.

omar_sre: Shadowing is great for data but watch resource contention. Do not allow shadow traffic to allocate KV cache in serving nodes. Also need per-region quota so a spike in shadow doesn't thrash pools.

eli_analytics: Measurement notes: we'll capture paired traces: actual route taken vs baseline route for same request id. Need events: routing_mode (control/shadow/active), latency_ms, token_delta, fallback_flag. I'll build paired-aggregate views.

tess_cs: Customer ask: pilot customers want an explicit "try optimized region" toggle in Console and an audit trail. They'll expect a rollback button.

migs_devex: Console/UI: can add a 3-state toggle: Off, Shadow, Active. Shadow mode shows per-tenant comparison charts. API mirror: POST /admin/tenants/{id}/routing-mode body: {mode: "shadow"}.

omar_sre: Rollout stages proposal:
- Stage 0: lab + staging verification (no tenants)
- Stage 1: Shadow two pilot tenants (manual opt-in) for 48h
- Stage 2: Auto-sample 1% of tenants to shadow for 72h (paired analysis)
- Stage 3: Holdback experiment: split eligible tenants into 3 cohorts (control, shadow, active) for A/B/C 7 days
- Stage 4: Gradual active ramp with capacity gates and emergency global holdback

sarah_prod: For the holdback (A/B/C) cohort sizes, suggest control 40%, shadow 40%, active 20% initially. We want strong control signal while limiting active exposure.

eli_analytics: Statistical plan: run permutation tests on p95 and cost-per-request. Use hierarchical modeling to account for tenant variance. We'll require 95% power to detect 10ms p95 reduction or 5% cost increase.

omar_sre: Automated fallback policy (router enforced):
- If region_pool_p95 > baseline_p95 + 15ms for 3 consecutive minutes -> mark pool degraded and divert active routes to fallback pool for impacted tenants.
- If region_pool_cpu > 85% for 5m -> reduce active capacity by 50% and escalate.
- If fallback_count > 2 for same tenant in 30m -> flip tenant to shadow and notify owners.

migs_devex: Feature flag schema (flat JSON; used by Admin API):
```
{
  "name": "routing.region_opt_v2",
  "modes": ["off","shadow","active"],
  "pilot_tenants": ["redwood-internal","pilot-acme"],
  "auto_sample_pct": 1,
  "holdback_cohorts": {"control": 40, "shadow": 40, "active": 20},
  "gates": {"p95_delta_ms": 15, "error_rate_pct": 1.0},
  "kill_switch": true,
  "audit_contact": "product/sarah_prod"
}
```

eli_analytics: Small ask: make sure each request has an id that survives routing so we can correlate control vs shadow traces. Also tag traces with feature_version.

tess_cs: For customer comms: we need a short FAQ that covers what shadow means, rollback procedures, and expected telemetry. I'll draft and share with Legal for wording.

omar_sre: Ops checklist before Stage 2:
- Create per-region dashboards: pool p50/p95/p99, queued_requests, fallback_rate
- Alerts: pool_p95 > baseline + 12ms (warning), >15ms (auto-divert)
- Capacity reservation: reserve 8% spare GPUs in region pools for emergency
- Runbook: manual reassign tenant cohorts if automation misfires

migs_devex: Console UX note: shadow charts should default to 24h paired view and allow rolling-window deltas. Also add a "recompute baseline" button to handle model upgrades.

eli_analytics: On analysis cadence: quick-check after 24h of shadow sampling, full paired report after 72h, and interim A/B/C analysis at day 7.

sarah_prod: Launch criteria checklist (all required):
- Pilot tenant feedback positive
- No auto-fallback incidents in Stage 2 > P0
- Analytics shows non-regression on p99 and <2% increase in token cost on avg
- Security sign-off on telemetry/pii handling
- Devex confirms Console toggle + API work

omar_sre: Security/PII constraints: strip prompt text from routing logs, hash tenant ids in long-term logs, encrypt routing decisions in transit and at rest. Add KMS key reference in flag config for Private installs.

migs_devex: Suggested API for flipping mode (example):
PATCH /admin/tenants/{tenant_id}/routing-mode
body: { "mode": "active", "reason": "pilot opt-in" }
Response: 202 + audit_id

eli_analytics: We'll publish a template report with metrics: paired_p95_diff, paired_cost_delta, fallback_rate, error_rate_change, cohort_significance.

tess_cs: I'll coordinate pilot onboarding and prepare an opt-in email template. Also will add a "revert" button in the Console near the toggle.

omar_sre: Final ops ask: add an emergency global holdback button in Console that forces all tenants to "shadow" and opens incident channel. Must emit an audit event and page on invocation.

infrabot: deploy queued: region-routing-feature flags + shadowing infra (deploy-2001). Estimated staging window tonight.

sarah_prod: Action items: 1) migs to land flag schema + API; 2) eli to wire paired traces + dashboards; 3) omar to prepare runbook + alerts; 4) tess to draft comms + revert UX; 5) infra to stage deploy. Target: start pilot opt-ins in 2 weeks.

migs_devex: I'll open PR with schema + admin API and include examples. Tagging everyone.

eli_analytics: I'll post links to dashboards once the tracing headers are live.

infrabot: deploy success: shadowing infra live in staging (deploy-2001).

vlad_p: Thanks team. Leaving thread open for any late objections. No objections so far, proceed with PRs.
